description: This file defines a mock class 'GstCapabilitiesFactoryMock' for testing purposes, which inherits from 'IGstCapabilitiesFactory' and mocks the 'createGstCapabilities' method. It is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and includes external dependencies such as 'IGstCapabilities.h' and Google Mock.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGstCapabilitiesFactory used in unit testing to simulate creation of GstCapabilities objects.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Mocked method that simulates creating a GstCapabilities object, returns a unique pointer to IGstCapabilities.
